observations: White home game console sitting on cardboard, with a layered front edge typical of a PlayStation 4 Slim.
Two red-and-white boxes labeled 'Wireless Controller' with PlayStation button symbols visible through clear windows.
Black power cable, HDMI cable, and USB cable coiled in front of the console.
Watermark 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' overlaid across the center of the image.
Reflection in glass behind shows a person and room interior.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a white console with no readable model label; PS4 Pro was not sold in white by Sony, but a skin or special edition cannot be ruled out remotely.
subjective performance claim; cannot be tested from photos.

risks.risk: Console is not a PlayStation 4 Pro (may be PS4 Slim, another model, or non-working).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model and serial label on the back or bottom of the console.

risks.risk: Console does not power on or output video.
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the home screen with a TV connected.

risks.risk: Controllers are not genuine, damaged, or do not sync.
risks.proof: Video of both controllers pairing with the console and being used in a game.

risks.risk: Cables are damaged, wrong type, or missing connectors.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both ends of the power, HDMI, and USB cables.

proof_requests: Photo of the model/serial label on the back or bottom of the console.
Video of the console powering on and displaying the home screen.
Video of both controllers connecting and responding.
Close-up photos of the cable connectors.
response.reason: The console model cannot be read from the photo, and the seller's 'PlayStation 4 Pro' claim is unverified; even a worst-case price requires knowing whether it is a Pro, Slim, or another model.
